# Provenance

Upstream: BlackOrchardLabs/swarm-harness
Commit: a6f7dbd0f37cfc4439d3ee4121942f71f77ab726
Tree: b8d7be6e00c22dd877a75d5d407e4237c9882c15
License: Apache-2.0

This directory contains the buildable source, tests, and gate scripts from the
certified commit. Development history, generated outputs, local configuration,
and non-runtime design records are intentionally excluded. Public-export
sanitization changes private attribution in user-visible authority strings to
the neutral term "operator" and records receipt output roots as relative paths
instead of host filesystem paths; the test suite is rerun after those changes.
